inlines.v: EMANA'TION, noun The act of flowing or proceeding from a fountain-head or origin. 1. That which issues, flows or proceeds from any source, substance or body; efflux; effluvium. Light is an emanation from the sun; wisdom, from God; the authority of laws, from the supreme power.
